results.name: Baseline (current live)
results.rationale: Current live config — establishes what we're beating

results.name: Tight loss cut: fearIdeal=25
results.rationale: Today's three -$72 losses suggest -$70 is too wide for current regime. Shano herself said -$10 cut in early interview. Test sharper cut.

results.name: Hold longer: fearIdeal=120, washout=200
results.rationale: Shano's actual stated rule (later interview): wait for losing trade to come back, no time limit. Push fearIdeal back so trades can recover.

results.name: Fast trail capture: trigger=4, drop=1
results.rationale: Win avg is only $24 — trail is too patient. Capture more small wins by triggering trail at +$4 (was $8) and exiting on $1 drop (was $2).

results.name: Let runners run: trigger=15, drop=4
results.rationale: The +$92 win shows big runs exist. Wider trail captures them.

results.name: Stricter probe confirm: 1.20
results.rationale: Many probes failing at -$3 means probe filter is too loose. Require stronger signal (probe to +$1.20 instead of +$0.58) before main.

results.name: No bursting: maxBurst=1
results.rationale: Two -$72 losses at same timestamp = burst overstaying its welcome. Disable bursting, take isolated trades only.

results.name: Combo: tightCut + fastTrail
results.rationale: Compress R:R on both sides. Smaller wins more often, smaller losses less often.

results.name: Combo: holdLonger + letRunners + stricterProbe
results.rationale: Fewer trades, higher quality, hold for big moves.

results.name: Smaller main size: probeFail=2.0 + main 0.20 (via override)
results.rationale: Half-size mains halve the dollar damage of any loss. Lets us test the strategy's edge without account-killing draws.
